items.quote: @correlation_coefficient[r_value] where "r_value" is a number between -1 and 1, rounded to two decimal places.
items.description: answer.txt 中答案項須為 @correlation_coefficient[數字] 格式，數值介於 -1 與 1 之間，四捨五入至小數兩位。

items.quote: Calculate the Pearson correlation coefficient (r) to assess the strength and direction of the linear relationship between number of cases and number of deaths.
items.description: 從 data/estimated_numbers.csv 重算 'No. of cases' 與 'No. of deaths' 兩欄的 Pearson 相關係數，與 answer.txt 的 @correlation_coefficient 值比對（四捨五入至兩位小數）。

items.quote: Convert the data types of 'No. of cases' and 'No. of deaths' column from Object (String) to Int64 before performing calculations.
items.description: 原始 'No. of cases'／'No. of deaths' 欄為含區間標記的字串，須先轉為整數（對應 median 數值欄）再計算；以重算 Pearson 係數驗證轉換後結果一致。

items.quote: Do this for complete data rather than specific country or year.
items.description: 相關係數須以整份資料（全部國家、全部年度）計算，不做任何國家或年度篩選；以全檔重算值比對驗證。

items.quote: The data file is input. Do not change it.
items.description: 資料檔 data/estimated_numbers.csv 僅為輸入，不得修改；此為檔案不變性要求，無法以現有 verifier 直接驗證檔案未被改動，設 unverified。
